# api.mikeodnis.dev

> Shared multi-service API gateway powering the *.mikeodnis.dev ecosystem: ElysiaJS + Bun Core Auth/Users API, Go Chi Media/R2 Upload API, Hasura GraphQL Engine, and Health Aggregator behind Caddy on Railway.

## Documentation & Discovery

- [API Console & Reference](https://api.mikeodnis.dev/): Human-readable Live Console overview, live health telemetry, rate limits, and working curl examples.
- [Unified Interactive OpenAPI Docs](https://api.mikeodnis.dev/docs): Multi-spec Scalar UI covering Core API, Media API, and CDN Edge API.
- [Core API Interactive Docs](https://api.mikeodnis.dev/v1/core/docs): Scalar reference for `/v1/core/*`.
- [Core OpenAPI 3.1 JSON](https://api.mikeodnis.dev/v1/core/openapi.json): Machine-readable Core API schema.
- [Media OpenAPI 3.0 JSON](https://api.mikeodnis.dev/v1/media/openapi.json): Machine-readable Media API schema.
- [Full LLM Technical Reference](https://api.mikeodnis.dev/llms-full.txt): Complete endpoints, authentication flows, rate-limit tiers, and working examples.
- [Security Contact](https://api.mikeodnis.dev/.well-known/security.txt): RFC 9116 vulnerability reporting.

## Services

- **Core Service (`/v1/core`)**: ElysiaJS + Bun — registration, login, rotating refresh tokens, HS256 JWTs (`exp` required) with Hasura claims, scoped `mk_live_*` API keys (`read` scope enforced; JWT-only key/account/admin management), user profiles, and runtime metrics (`/v1/core/status`).
- **Media Service (`/v1/media`)**: Go Chi — magic-byte & SVG verified multipart uploads (up to 100 MiB; SVG 2 MiB) to Cloudflare R2, quarantined `staging/*` presigned PUTs with ETag-pinned atomic promotion, HMAC-SHA256 `private/*` CDN URL signing, asset listing/deletion, and Cloudflare edge cache purging.
- **Links GraphQL (`/v1/links/graphql`, `/v1/links/v1/graphql`)**: Allow-listed Hasura GraphQL Engine (`256KB` body cap; admin/metadata/SQL/console routes blocked at gateway) serving `links.mikeodnis.dev`.
- **Health Aggregator (`/health`)**: 2s coalesced liveness and dependency health across all platform services (sanitized, no internal URLs).

- CDN & Upload Studio PWA: https://cdn.mikeodnis.dev (Upload UI: https://cdn.mikeodnis.dev/upload)
